entries.problem: destination path 'upstream' already exists
entries.cause: workflow cloned into 'upstream/', a tracked dir of this repo
entries.solution: clone into 'mirror/' instead; keep clone dirs out of tracked paths

entries.problem: Glean bootstrap (Miniconda3) not idempotent
entries.cause: wrapper re-downloaded every build
entries.solution: make bootstrap idempotent; skip when already present

entries.problem: full build ~40 min on free runner
entries.cause: GeckoView AAR download + R8 + all ABIs
entries.solution: arm64-only split, Gradle/Rust/Maven caches, fast=true (no R8) for validation, --parallel when stable

entries.problem: removeUnusedEntriesOlderThan write-only property crash
entries.cause: gradle-build-action v3 cleanup incompatible with Gradle 9.5.1
entries.solution: pin gradle-build-action v2 (upstream-proven)

entries.problem: APK not found (first time)
entries.cause: hardcoded AGP output path; ABI selection changes output layout
entries.solution: find-based discovery, name-agnostic

entries.problem: APK not found (second time)
entries.cause: unsigned APKs named '*-forkRelease-unsigned.apk' (no signing config)
entries.solution: discovery handles '-unsigned'; sign step renames to .apk

entries.problem: AAPT unexpected package id
entries.cause: OP7 patch appends '.iceraven.op7' to app id
entries.solution: expect the patched id; derive at runtime from patches + defaultConfig

entries.problem: sign action 'build-tools not found'
entries.cause: action read ANDROID_HOME (runner SDK), we used ANDROID_SDK_ROOT (custom SDK)
entries.solution: compute BUILD_TOOLS_VERSION from ANDROID_HOME like upstream; read third-party action source before use

entries.problem: GitHub cache service outage (400 / services unavailable)
entries.cause: GitHub-side transient
entries.solution: cache misses are warnings not failures; stable cache keys; next run restores

entries.problem: R8 OOM risk with --parallel on 2-core/7 GB runner
entries.cause: workers vs heap
entries.solution: tune GRADLE_OPTS, limit --max-workers, keep release builds serial if flaky

entries.problem: 'native-code' badging line missing
entries.cause: ABI selection ignored by some AGP versions
entries.solution: validation gates fail loudly; configure splits.abi explicitly

entries.problem: release asset became stale bytes
entries.cause: validation build overwrote release asset data
entries.solution: compare bytes; only update release asset from a validated release=true run

entries.problem: PKCS12 alias mismatch risk
entries.cause: keystore alias vs secret
entries.solution: document exact alias; validate at first release

entries.problem: release tag immutability
entries.cause: GitHub tags are immutable
entries.solution: fix version/tag in the dispatch; never reuse a tag

entries.problem: APK commits sneaking into the repo
entries.cause: git add -A picked up 3x126 MB APKs in a gitignored dir (tracked before ignore added)
entries.solution: git rm --cached; verify git ls-files empty; keep binaries out of git history

entries.problem: old artifacts/runs wasted the 500 MB quota
entries.cause: 90-day default retention
entries.solution: monthly maintenance workflow prunes >14 d artifacts/caches, keeps newest 20 runs

entries.problem: App not installed
entries.cause: APK flagged android:testOnly=true (Studio-injected build flag); Android 10 blocks UI installs
entries.solution: remove injected flag; splits.abi arm64-only; CI badging gate rejects testOnly; verify pm install -r without -t

entries.problem: pm install -r from /sdcard/Download returns 255
entries.cause: opaque failure installing directly from FUSE path
entries.solution: copy to /data/local/tmp first, then pm install -r

entries.problem: app open but Shizuku not connected
entries.cause: Shizuku server stopped or killed by battery optimization
entries.solution: shizuku whoami must print 'shell'; retry loops; user reopens Shizuku

entries.problem: wrong activity launched in scripted runs
entries.cause: assistant app foreground; HOME keyevent ineffective in proot env
entries.solution: verify mCurrentFocus; use explicit component; validate LaunchState/Activity in logs

entries.problem: am start with HomeActivity failed (Error type 3: activity does not exist)
entries.cause: launcher activity is the Fenix delegate `.App`, and the package id is io.github.forkmaintainers.iceraven.op7 (not org.mozilla.fenix.iceraven.op7)
entries.solution: resolve the launcher with `cmd package resolve-activity --brief -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER <pkg>` before launching

entries.problem: user asked to undo bulk per-user uninstalls on a daily-driver phone
entries.cause: cleanup removed 12 already-disabled packages via pm uninstall --user 0 without asking first
entries.solution: restore exactly via `pm install-existing --user 0 <pkg>` then `pm disable-user --user 0 <pkg>`; verify with `pm list packages -d` matches the original list. Rule: on a daily-driver, present a candidate list and get a go-ahead before uninstalling packages; files/app-data need explicit confirmation too

entries.problem: am start -W returns TotalTime 0
entries.cause: activity still top-most; not a launch at all
entries.solution: background between runs; filter LaunchState: COLD; warm-start needs adb

entries.problem: proot files invisible to the real device shell (shizuku)
entries.cause: proot runs inside the app (gptos.intelligence.assistant); its /storage/emulated/0 is an app-private bind, not the real /sdcard
entries.solution: proot shares the device network, so serve the APK with a persistent loopback HTTP server (setsid nohup python3 -m http.server) and pull with curl on the real shell to /sdcard/Download/op7/; verify size; copy to /data/local/tmp then pm install -r

entries.problem: verify GeckoView uses hardware video decoding before touching media prefs
entries.cause: hardware decoders exist (Phase 5) but usage was unverified; changing prefs on assumptions is banned by the golden rule
entries.solution: media_probe.sh — force-stop, clear logcat, open a direct 1080p clip in Iceraven, sample top every 4s, dump logcat + dumpsys media.player; GeckoView's HardwareCodecCapability log names the selected decoder

entries.problem: summary CPU parse showed a fake 1034% spike in the probe
entries.cause: naive grep of leading digits grabbed the wrong column from top output
entries.solution: report peak from raw per-process samples; verify against cpu-all.txt before trusting a number

entries.problem: "3/6/10 tabs" memory captures were invalid — no new tabs were actually opened
entries.cause: repeated `am start -a VIEW -d <url>` on an already-foreground Fenix reuses the existing tab/task instead of creating new tabs; user confirmed no new tabs appeared
entries.solution: validate tab creation before measuring (uiautomator dump + user observation); VIEW-intent counts are not tab counts. Correct path: user opens tabs manually, or tap the real "New tab" toolbar node (from the Iceraven a11y dump) then drive the awesome bar

entries.problem: a11y dumps can show the WRONG app — the gptos assistant overlay, not the browser
entries.cause: the assistant host app renders its own floating UI on top; `uiautomator dump` captured that package's nodes
entries.solution: grep the dump for package="...iceraven..." and confirm mCurrentFocus before trusting coordinates/taps

entries.problem: needed real per-tab memory data but VIEW intents cannot create tabs in a foreground Fenix
entries.cause: repeated VIEW intents reuse the current tab (see D13); UI automation is blocked by the host app overlay (D14)
entries.solution: collaborative measurement — user opens 3/6/10 tabs by hand, `baseline_capture.sh state <n>` captures meminfo + processes as-is without force-stop

entries.problem: browser restarted between captures, changing the main pid and invalidating one sample
entries.cause: app instance churn mid-test (no crash logged); transient
entries.solution: use only settled states; verify pid + process set consistency before trusting a capture; retry truncated meminfo captures (146-byte truncation seen once)

entries.problem: "Remote debugging via USB" enabled but port 6000 not listening
entries.cause: GeckoView's remote debugger listens on a Unix abstract socket (io.github.forkmaintainers.iceraven.op7/firefox-debugger-socket), not TCP; adb forward is the normal bridge
entries.solution: verified via logcat `GeckoViewRemoteDebugger: listening on .../firefox-debugger-socket`

entries.problem: cannot reach the abstract socket without adb
entries.cause: SELinux denies the proot app domain (EACCES on connect); shell toybox nc has no -U; user declined adb authorization
entries.solution: accept the constraint — devtools measurement channel is unavailable on this setup; keep Shizuku dumpsys/top/logcat as the measurement stack

entries.problem: C1 'verified' was wrong — codec enumeration is not playback
entries.cause: r5 probe logged HardwareCodecCapability decoder selection + low CPU, but the probe clip URLs were 404, so no MediaCodec session ever ran; 'verified' was inferred, not observed
entries.solution: prove playback three ways: (1) fixture page beacons currentTime to a local HTTP server every 2 s (time-series must advance), (2) logcat must show a live MediaCodec session (OMX.qcom.video.decoder.*, component_init success, surface generation set) in our media pid, (3) user confirms video visible on screen

entries.problem: captured files empty (gfxinfo 0 B)
entries.cause: Shizuku wrapper races: large remote output streams to tty, local pipe gets 0 bytes
entries.solution: stage output to on-device temp file; pull with wc -c size probe + retry until sizes match

entries.problem: muted video never plays when tab goes background; decoder deinit on backgrounding
entries.cause: Gecko pauses muted background media (correct energy behavior); audible media keeps playing with decoder alive
entries.solution: for background-capable media tests: let the page unmute+play on a user tap (autoplay policy), then capture dumpsys/logcat from the agent side while user keeps chatting

entries.problem: VIEW intent on already-running Fenix task does not deliver the URL
entries.cause: am start -n on a foreground activity logs 'Activity not started' and only brings the task forward; new tab was never fetched (background tabs don't fetch until foregrounded)
entries.solution: cold-start reliably: am force-stop, then am start with the intent; or let the chooser resolve (no -n); drive navigation by tapping the URL bar + input text + keyevent 66

entries.problem: alias URL http://127.0.0.1:8790/s rendered a blank page in Iceraven
entries.cause: the alias file 's' has no extension; python http.server serves it as application/octet-stream, and Gecko refuses to render a binary blob as HTML — page fetches 200 but shows nothing, JS never runs
entries.solution: always give fixture files a .html extension (or set MIME) — check Content-Type before relying on a local fixture; blank page + 200 = wrong MIME, not a browser bug

entries.problem: dumpsys gfxinfo <pkg> framestats showed 0 frames while the page was actively scrolling
entries.cause: gfxinfo measures only the main process; WebRender content renders in :tab_* and :gpu processes, so page frames never appear in the package's gfxinfo
entries.solution: measure compositor-level smoothness with dumpsys SurfaceFlinger --latency '<pkg>/<activity>#0' (line 1 = refresh ns, rows = desired/actual/ready); only judge deltas during continuous motion (idle gaps are not jank)

entries.problem: intent-opened URL tab never ran JS (no beacons) and showed blank/frozen
entries.cause: cold start with VIEW intent restores the old session in front and adds the URL tab in the background; background tabs suspend JS timers/rAF until foregrounded
entries.solution: foreground-only web tests: have the user paste the URL in the address bar (works reliably), or use the chooser route; don't expect the intent tab to run until it is the active tab

entries.problem: exit codes unreliable through Shizuku
entries.cause: wrapper mangles remote exit codes
entries.solution: verify by output content (pidof empty, 'Complete' marker)

entries.problem: GitHub artifact downloads truncated (4+ aborts)
entries.cause: unreliable network
entries.solution: local python3 -m http.server loopback transfer; 131 MB in ~1.5 s; SHA-256 verify

entries.problem: /sdcard files from shell unreadable by app proot
entries.cause: FUSE permission model; chmod unsupported
entries.solution: transfer via app-visible storage or MediaStore; verify sizes

entries.problem: bsh stdout looks odd
entries.cause: returns JSON envelope {result,output}; no readAllBytes() (old Java)
entries.solution: parse JSON; read streams with BufferedReader loops

entries.problem: warm-start impossible in proot env
entries.cause: HOME no-op; am finish and am task move-task-to-back unknown on this Android build; BACK intercepted
entries.solution: record as pending; needs adb or HOME-capable session

entries.problem: dumpsys meminfo/gfxinfo returned 'No process found' or empty
entries.cause: app process was force-stopped by the preceding cold-start loop
entries.solution: launch the app and let it render BEFORE capturing mem/gfx (cmd_mem launches; run gfx after mem)

entries.problem: large dumpsys outputs (>40 KB) only partially pull through Shizuku
entries.cause: wrapper stdout race gets worse with payload size; 400 KB batterystats truncated at 82% after 15 retries
entries.solution: accept partial captures and label them, or use chunked pulls / adb / MediaStore for full captures

entries.problem: CI red after merge
entries.cause: shellcheck SC2129 (individual >> redirects to summary)
entries.solution: group echos with { ...; } >> file

entries.problem: testOnly gate missing
entries.cause: validation gap
entries.solution: badging step fails when testOnly=true appears

entries.problem: scheduled workflow 60-day caveat
entries.cause: GitHub policy for public repos
entries.solution: daily check + dispatch + monthly maintenance reset the activity window; manual/repo-dispatch secondary

entries.problem: r3 build failed at app:compileForkReleaseKotlin
entries.cause: missing import for DeviceCapabilities in HomeActivity; PackageManager.getSystemFeatureInfo/FEATURE_OPENGLES_* unresolved in this module (used deviceConfigurationInfo.reqGlEsVersion instead)
entries.solution: review imports before shipping a patch; prefer deviceConfigurationInfo for GLES version; ALWAYS re-stage BOTH files before regenerating a patch (git reset unstaged them and the regenerated patch silently lost the HomeActivity hunks)

entries.problem: r3 build failed at app:compileForkReleaseKotlin (Unresolved references)
entries.cause: missing DeviceCapabilities import in HomeActivity; PackageManager feature APIs unresolved in this module
entries.solution: added import; use deviceConfigurationInfo.reqGlEsVersion for GLES; review imports/APIs before dispatching

entries.problem: full 40-min build wasted on a compile error
entries.cause: dispatched full build before local review of the Kotlin patch
entries.solution: use fast=true validation builds during patch iteration (compile-level proof, cheap); full R8 only when ready

entries.problem: regenerated patch silently lost hunks after git reset
entries.cause: git reset unstaged files; regenerated diff from only one staged file
entries.solution: always re-stage ALL touched files before regenerating a patch; verify patch touches expected files (grep '^diff --git')

entries.problem: visible color jump between splash and home screen on launch
entries.cause: hard-coded splash brand color (#FCF3EE / #210340) differs from home surface (#F7F6FB / #1D1B1F)
entries.solution: splash background references @color/fx_mobile_surface (patch 004) — seamless iOS-style launch, cosmetic only

entries.problem: full journey tables (docs/09, projects/*/README.md) cost agents too many tokens
entries.cause: every entry rendered in one big markdown table; an agent must read all of it to find one answer
entries.solution: notes/ layer — INDEX.md keyword->ids map (grep-able, ~150 lines), one entries/<id>.md per problem, lookup.py ranked search; agents read only the matching entry

entries.problem: keyword auto-extraction produced a noisy index (478 lines of '1.5', '2-core', 'add')
entries.cause: naive tokenization of problem+cause+solution text
entries.solution: curated INDEX from problem text + explicit tags only; full text kept in index.json for ranked lookup.py matching; stopwords + prefix-collapse

entries.problem: conversation digests lived only in the build repo, not the playbook
entries.cause: playbook sync fetched only log.yml
entries.solution: sync also lists docs/field-notes/sessions and fetches each *.md (skip _template) into _logs/sessions/<slug>/; SESSIONS.md generated with summaries

entries.problem: optional tags would be stripped by session_to_notes re-render
entries.cause: canonical renderer wrote only id/problem/cause/solution
entries.solution: renderer + digest parser now carry tags: [...] through
